title: Chocolate Cosmos
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Fifteen-year-old Sayuki Sakurai looks fierce but is a romantic at heart. On a summer beach trip she meets a kind young man who turns out to be her new home-economics teacher, and she develops a crush on him. Much of the story follows her sorting out what she wants, including feelings for her childhood friend Yushi.
life_message: A good life means understanding your own heart and choosing love honestly, beyond how others misjudge you.

content.note: Low-key melodrama balanced with humor (Reverse Thieves).

A 15-year-old student's romantic crush on her teacher, which a reviewer says seems mutual (Reverse Thieves; AniList and MangaUpdates Student-Teacher, Age Gap tags). No physical romance described; reviewer calls it consequence-free fantasy.
Student-teacher romance framed as escapist fantasy without consequences (Reverse Thieves).
